chain: The real-shape decide (build_decision_request payload) took 35.34s against the 4-slot Clef — over the 30s httpx timeout -> PlayingBackendError -> the w50 tick failures and the w50/51 both-stalls. The hand-made probes that 'passed' were malformed (the server's 400s named the missing fields), masking this for hours.

35s = ~63 tok/s prefill = CPU speed: the 4-slot Clef launched WHILE the restarted chat server held the iGPU -> its HIP offload failed silently -> CPU fallback. Killing the chat (relaunched -ngl 0 on CPU) helped only partially (35->still 35) because the Clef process itself had already fallen back.

A CLEAN Clef restart with the GPU free: 12.5-19.6s cold decides (under the timeout) — the agents' repeated prompts will KV-cache-hit far faster (the historical wedged-server log shows same-shape tasks releasing in ~0.5s).
Lesson: any backend relaunch must happen with the GPU otherwise free, and the validation probe must use the REAL request shape (build_decision_request), not a hand-made one.
